name: @pipeworx/mcp-bundlephobia

tools.name: size
tools.description: Bundle size analysis — minified + gzipped, tree-shakeability, dependencies, esm/cjs detection.

tools.name: similar
tools.description: Return npm packages with similar functionality to the given package, each with their minified + gzipped bundle sizes, to aid migration or replacement decisions.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Fetch minified + gzipped bundle size for each of up to 5 specified versions of an npm package and return them side-by-side for size regression tracking.

versions.description: Comma-sep version list (max 5 to avoid timeouts)

tools.name: recent_searches
tools.description: Return the list of npm packages most recently measured on bundlephobia.com, showing current community interest in bundle-size analysis.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bundlephobia forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bundlephobia pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
